summary.value: Hyatt House New York/Chelsea is an extended-stay hotel at Hyatt House New York/Chelsea 815 Avenue of the Americas, with Kitchen Suites, a 24/7 H Market, a 24/7 Fitness Room and Pet-friendly accommodations. It suits families and longer trips that want to cook sometimes and eat out the rest. Trip.com guests rate it 8.4 / 10 Very good 121 reviews and say “Love the breakfast. All the staffs are friendly”, though one wishes for more variety: “I wish there were more vegetables for breakfast”.

Trip.com shows 8.4 / 10 Very good 121 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Love the breakfast. All the staffs are friendly”.
